messages:
Amee (infra): heads-up — since the subnet tag enforcement rollout at 03:15UTC, I'm seeing ~12 prod-eu GPU nodes stuck Pending. ENI attach gets rejected by the subnet tag policy (tag expected: infra:managed=true, actual on new subnets: infra:managed=false)
Sam (sre): saw the same. autoscaler kept launching more which spiked our scaling and cost alerts. :grimacing: autoscaler logs: `AttachNetworkInterface failed: AccessDenied: subnet does not match tag allowlist`
ops-bot: autoscaler:scaled_up group=llm-prod-eu-gpu count=8 reason=scale-up-healthcheck-failure
Amee (infra): quick snippet from `kubectl describe` on one node:
```
Events:
  Type     Reason                 Age   From               Message
  ----     ------                 ----  ----               -------
  Normal   RegisteredNode         20s   kubelet            Node registered
  Warning  FailedAttachInterface  18s   eni-controller     AttachNetworkInterface failed: AccessDenied: subnet tag mismatch
```
Sam (sre): temporary mitigation idea — we can add the required tag to the new subnets that the ASG is using, but that only helps future launches. Current Pending nodes need manual reconcile or reboot to retry attach once tags are fixed.
security-jen: reminder — the tag enforcement was put in place for PCI/audit compliance; we can't just disable it permanently. If we relax it we need an approved drift window and an audit log entry.
Lina (platform): can we exempt the autoscaler launch role or the ASG from the tag-check policy? That would be least disruptive and keep audit trail intact.
Dave (oncall): verified that the audit-shipper (logs -> S3) also started failing when the autoscaler caused many node boot sequences. Ship backlog grew from 0 to ~120k events, several retry errors include `AccessDenied: PutObject` — looks like the deployment IAM role lost the s3:PutObject right when we swapped the role policy last week. Might be two correlated rollouts.
Amee (infra): ugh, two rollouts overlapped. One changed subnet tagging rules (sg-policy v3), another tightened the infra logging role (logship-role v2). Both merged to prod within 45m.
Sam (sre): short plan: 1) add infra:managed=true to pending-launch subnets (fast) 2) patch ASG launch template to include tag on ENIs so future nodes come up clean (medium) 3) open a change for the tag-enforcement policy to allow a scoped exception for autoscaler role with timeboxed approval (安全) 4) rollback logship-role policy to previous version to drain S3 backlog (if security signs off)
security-jen: I can approve a 60m emergency exception for the autoscaler role if we get a traceable ticket and a compensating control (we'll enable VPC flow logs for those subnets and increase audit retention for 7 days).
Lina (platform): I'll run the launch-template patch and add the ENI tag — rolling update to happen in 15m. putting a hold on further tag enforcement rollouts.
Dave (oncall): I'll start the S3 retry/rewind for logship and watch for token churn. If we need to rollback the policy, call me.
Amee (infra): created ticket INFRA-4821 for the emergency exception + audit evidence. I'll attach the `kubectl describe` output and the ASG IDs.
Sam (sre): estimate: if we tag pending subnets now + patch launch template, nodes should join within ~8-12 minutes and autoscaler will stop spawning. cost spike contained.
ops-bot: incident-tracker:incident_created id=INFRA-4821 severity=high owner=Amee
Amee (infra): action items: Lina patch launch template (15m), Dave manage logship roll/drain (ASAP), security-jen approve exception (60m window), Sam watch autoscaler and scale down excess once nodes are healthy.
security-jen: will review and post approval in INFRA-4821 in 5m. please include the exact IAM ARNs to exempt.
Sam (sre): after this, we should add a preflight check to deploy pipelines: detect overlapping infra/security rollouts touching subnet tags/IAM; tie them in the release automation to block simultaneous high-risk changes.
Amee (infra): agreed. quick follow-up: add a tag-checker in terraform plan CI to fail if both changes are in flight.
Lina (platform): deploying now, will post status in 10m.
Dave (oncall): monitoring logs + cost dashboard. ping me if backlog >200k events.
Amee (infra): thanks team — will update when nodes are healthy.
